items.title: John L. Jones Interview, 1972-06-05
items.q: Well, he was with King Oliver. He stayed with King Oliver until King Oliver died.

ctx.x: I've heard him on record. How you like him? Oh, he was fine. I never heard Herman Franklin. I met him, but I never heard him.

Well, he was with King Oliver. He stayed with King Oliver until King Oliver died. He was with Celestan too for a while. Yeah, I know. He came with Celestan. He was with Celestan before King Oliver died. Now, after King Oliver died, he came back to Celestan.
He still got a little bit left on the tape. And trombone players, they haven't he got trombone players?
